title: Food delivery dispatch: traces that fall apart under fan-out
name: Dispatch tracing

questions.prompt: In the tracing UI, an order now shows up as one trace for the HTTP handler and then two more unrelated one-span traces for courier assignment and fare quoting, so we cannot see where the time goes for slow orders. The handler's own trace and the headers sent to the restaurant look right. Fix dispatch/tracer.go so the tests pass.
